items.title: Ethereal news #15
items.note: 会议内容引自 Ethereal news #15：Glamsterdam 的 bal-devnet-3 推迟上线，EIP-8037 提高状态创建 gas 成本引发复杂度担忧；Hegotá 执行层头号提案将在下次 ACDE 决定，默认不设，EIP-8141 frame 交易是唯一剩余候选，获 Geth 与 Erigon 支持，需更多团队支持才能入选；EIP-8184 LUCID 加密交易池与 EIP-7807 SSZ 执行区块被拒绝纳入。
items.note_en: Call notes are from Ethereal news #15: Glamsterdam's bal-devnet-3 launch was delayed over complexity concerns about EIP-8037's higher state creation gas cost; the Hegotá EL headliner will be decided at the next ACDE, defaulting to none, with EIP-8141 frame transactions the only remaining candidate, backed by Geth and Erigon and needing more teams to be selected; EIP-8184 LUCID encrypted transaction pool and EIP-7807 SSZ execution blocks were declined for inclusion.

items.title: EIP-8141：为 frame 加入批准位
items.note: （fjl）提交并合并：在 frame 的 mode 中加入配置位，限制该 frame 能 APPROVE 的范围，让用户能告诉自己的账户该批准什么，同时仍可直接对交易 sighash 签名；EIP-8141：清理 frame 访问操作码（fjl）提交并合并，新增读取 frame 输入数据的专用操作码。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: add approval bits to frame
items.note_en: (fjl), submitted and merged: adds configuration bits to a frame's mode that constrain what it can APPROVE, letting users tell their own account what to approve while still signing the transaction sighash directly; EIP-8141: clean up frame access opcodes (fjl), submitted and merged, adding dedicated opcodes for reading frame input data.

summary_en: ACDE #232 agreed to decide the Hegotá EL headliner at the next ACDE, defaulting to none, with EIP-8141 frame transactions the only remaining candidate, backed so far by Geth and Erigon. fjl added frame approval bits to EIP-8141 and cleaned up frame access opcodes, both submitted and merged. _julianma argued Ethereum urgently needs an encrypted mempool.
